description: The Crown Council, a multidisciplinary team combining AI, software, data science, research, and creative design to build innovative solutions using NASA’s open data.
summary:
PROMETHEUS is an AI-assisted scientific intelligence platform developed by The Crown Council for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the challenge “Flame in Freefall.”

The project explores how combustion behaves in microgravity and how NASA research can support spacecraft fire-safety investigations. It transforms NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) research into an interactive environment where users can explore experiments, compare conditions, examine scientific data, and investigate combustion-related findings.

Its key features include a NASA evidence explorer, an AI research assistant, interactive scientific visualizations, experiment comparisons, and source-linked research insights. The platform organizes experimental information involving oxygen concentration, pressure, fuel characteristics, and other available combustion parameters.

PROMETHEUS emphasizes scientific transparency by distinguishing NASA-reported evidence from derived statistics, AI interpretations, and unknown information. Its goal is to make complex microgravity combustion research more accessible, understandable, and useful for further investigation.

By connecting NASA research with AI-assisted analysis and interactive exploration, PROMETHEUS aims to support future research into safer human space exploration.
details: PROMETHEUS — AI-ASSISTED SCIENTIFIC INTELLIGENCE Developed by The Crown Council for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, under Flame in Freefall. 1. Our Solution PROMETHEUS transforms NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) combustion research into an interactive environment for exploring microgravity experiments. Users can browse investigations, examine experimental parameters, compare research records, and explore scientific evidence. 2. Core Features • NASA Evidence Explorer: Source-linked research investigations and experimental records. • AI Research Assistant: Helps users investigate questions through a THINK → FETCH NASA DATA → RESPONSE workflow. • Interactive Visualizations: Charts, distributions, and comparisons of available experimental data. • Evidence Tracking: Distinguishes NASA-reported findings from derived statistics, model interpretations, and unknown information. 3. Technology JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, PyTorch, Node.js, and Capacitor power the web application, research analysis, and Android integration. 4. Innovation and Impact PROMETHEUS combines AI-assisted research, scientific evidence, and interactive exploration in one workspace. Its goal is to make complex microgravity combustion research more accessible and support future investigations into spacecraft fire safety. PROMETHEUS is a research-support prototype, not a certified fire-risk prediction system.
